title: Fall $$2023$$ Midterm
body: Selected questions from the Fall $$2023$$ Midterm. Q5(c): Rohan brings in a new variable $$z_i$$ to predict $$y_i$$ for $$i$$ $$\in$$ $$\{1$$, $$\dots$$, $$n\}\$\$;$$ $$a$$ $$scatterplot$$ $$of$$ $$z_i$$ vs $$y_i$$ is provided. [IMAGE NEEDED: scatterplot of $$y_i$$ (0 to ~350) vs $$z_i$$ (0 to 10); $$y_i$$ grows in a curved, roughly quadratic fashion, from near $$0$$ at $$z_i=0$$ to about $$300$$ at $$z_i=10\$\$.]$$ $$Q6$$: $$Tina$$ $$wants$$ $$to$$ $$use$$ $$OLS$$ $$to$$ $$predict$$ $$a$$ $$person's$$ $$height$$, $$stored$$ $$in$$ $$a$$ $$vector$$ $$Y$$. $$She$$ $$makes$$ $$use$$ $$of$$ $$an$$ $$m$$ $$\times$$ $$n$$ design matrix $$X$$, $$which$$ $$contains$$ $$m$$ rows and $$n$$ columns, including a column representing the intercept. Assume that $$X$$ and $$Y$$ meet all the requirements for OLS.
